## Backtest summary

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="stat-grid">${Object.entries(data.statistics).map(([k, v]) =>
  html`<div class="stat-tile"><div class="label">${k}</div><div class="value">${v}</div></div>`)}</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<p><small>Backtest period ${data.meta.start} to ${data.meta.end}. Hypothetical results. Source backtest ID: <code>${data.meta.backtest_id}</code>, retrieved ${data.meta.retrieved}.</small></p>`
```

## Equity curve

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
equity = data.equity.map(d => ({date: new Date(d.date), value: d.value}))
Plot.plot({
  height: 340,
  marginLeft: 60,
  x: {label: null},
  y: {label: "Portfolio value", grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.lineY(equity, {x: "date", y: "value", stroke: "#0F6E56", strokeWidth: 1.5, tip: true}),
    Plot.ruleY([equity[0].value], {stroke: "currentColor", strokeOpacity: 0.3, strokeDasharray: "4 4"})
  ]
})
```
